brand_architecture: MobileNetV3 Small + average/max pooling + 1152->256 Hardswish/dropout + 13-brand head
detector: Faster R-CNN ResNet50 FPN v2 COCO (640/1024 px)
general_initialization: ImageNet/COCO explicitly authorized by owner; no ready-made car-brand classifier
colour: Independently trained VCoR colour MLP over general ImageNet features and original RGB/HSV statistics
brand_scope: 13 known brands, human annotated ground-truth car crops; not full-scene accuracy and not unknown-brand accuracy
